rules.description: Evaluation logic must handle batched tensors, not individual scalars.
rules.instruction: Do NOT iterate over N individuals. Translate complex mathematical formulas directly into PyTorch broadcasting semantics.

rules.description: Evaluation often involves division which can lead to NaN if vectors are zero.
rules.instruction: Always protect division operations with `torch.clamp(denominator, min=1e-8)` or use `torch.nan_to_num`.

rules.description: Constants and formula structures must strictly mirror the MATLAB code.
rules.instruction: NEVER simplify or drop parts of objective equations (e.g. cosine penalties). Transcribe exactly.

rules.description: Direct subtraction of unmatched tensors causes runtime crashes.
rules.instruction: Explicitly use `.unsqueeze()` to align dimensions before applying arithmetic operations across different axes.

rules.description: MATLAB often uses col-major for individuals. EvoX expects (N, D).
rules.instruction: If the source evaluates on columns `(D, N)`, you must adapt the formula for row-major `(N, D)`.
